items.desc: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
items.readme: Auto Ontology Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. items.desc: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
items.readme: agent-browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. `snapshot` returns the page as compact text with a ref such as `@e1` for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install Homebrew:** `brew install agent-browser`, then `agent-browser install`. Linux:** `agent-browser install --with-deps` also installs the browser's system libraries.
